The Art Of Engineering
40 engineers and two years later, we bring
you what just might be the last power supply
you'll ever buy. Designed, sourced and
manufactured in Japan, we achieved and we
created a PSU that exceeds Titanium
efficiency. Its current is so smooth and stable,
its temperatures so low, that we needed new
standards to measure them.

efficiency at 50% load
Better Transformer: Utilizing a Murata
made stacked planar transformer, we have
less heat loss and a more efficient energy
conversion.

starts spinning at a load of 600W and is
quiet under load
Exclusive design: Our Limited Edition
Power supply has Murata designed
components that tightly control EMI and
Ripple.
